Admin & MC Trade Guide

Greater Akron Chamber · Card Scanner · version 0.4.2

For the person who runs the scanner and does the MC Trade import. Reviewing cards is in the Reviewer Guide.

1. Install (once)

  1. Run GAC-Card-Scanner-Setup.exe (Windows) or open the .dmg (Mac: arm64 for Apple chips, x86_64 for Intel).
  2. Open GAC Card Scanner. First time: First-time setup creates the first admin.
  3. Admin → Reviewers: add one account per person.

First-time setup works only on the scanner computer.

2. Every day

  • Open GAC Card Scanner. Keep it open while people work.
  • AI check (optional): Admin → Settings → AI helper → Download, then Start. Scanning works without it.
  • Scan with phone: on Scan cards, under More. Same office Wi-Fi. The QR link expires after 15 minutes.

3. Backups

  • Automatic every night at 02:30. The last 7 are kept, in backups/.
  • Put them on another disk: start with GAC_BACKUP_DIR=<folder>.
  • Restore: stop the scanner, run scripts/restore_backup.sh <file>, type YES.

4. Who may export

Who May export
Reviewer Approved cards of their own batch only
Admin Any batch, All batches, pending or rejected cards too

The server enforces this. An admin exporting someone else's batch is asked first; Cancel is the default.

5. Export

  1. Export. Your current batch is chosen.
  2. Preview shows the rows and what's left out.
  3. Export → Ready to save → Save. Other formats are under Format.
On the sheet Means
New contacts Rows in the import file
Updates Rows in the UPDATES file
To check Cards with a Check line in the READ-ME

You get 3 files. Import only the .xlsx. Read the Check lines first.

6. MC Trade import: first time

  1. MC Trade Admin → Manage Codes: create CardScan-Pilot.
  2. MC Trade Admin → Import Profiles → Download Template. Upload it in Admin → Settings → MC Trade template.
  3. MC Trade Profile Selector → Export All System Columns. Upload it in Admin → Settings → MC Trade contacts.
  4. Export → Look up in MC Trade (a dry run). Fix every FIX FIRST row. Decide every NEEDS REVIEW row.
  5. Test 2 rows first. An import can't be undone.
  6. Import in order: organizations, individuals, then updates (separately).

Nothing is sent to MC Trade by the scanner.

7. Settings

Setting Default
AI double-check On when the AI helper runs
Affiliation code (AffCode1) CardScan-Pilot
Allow "update existing contact" Off. Turn on after one tested update import.
Phone format 330-555-0181
Keep corrected cards as test examples Off
Delete photos after 30 days (never while pending)
Delete export copies after 30 days

Click Save settings.

8. Accounts

  • Add reviewer: name, username, initials, role, temporary password (10+ characters).
  • Reset password also lifts a lock.
  • Deactivate someone who left. Their history stays.
  • Idle sign-out: after 30 minutes with no clicks. Change it with GAC_IDLE_MINUTES=<minutes> (0 = off).

Locked out of every admin account: python -m app.admin reset-password <username> in the scanner folder.

9. Archive and audit

  • Archive batch (Review queue): hidden, not deleted. Undo brings it back.
  • Archive all test data (Settings): type CLEAR.
  • Admin → Audit log: who did what, when. Download as CSV.

10. Removal requests

  1. Review queue → All: search the name or email. Open the card.
  2. More → Delete… → Delete permanently. It can't be undone.
  3. Repeat for any other card of that person.
  4. Remove them from MC Trade too, and delete exported files that hold them.

11. Problems

Problem Do this
"AI check is off" Scanning still works. Settings → AI helper → Start.
Export blocked Open the listed cards. Answer Same or Different.
"Something changed" on Save Someone edited a card. Check, then save again.
Phone can't connect Same Wi-Fi. Allow Private networks in the firewall.
Sign-in locked Admin → Reviewers → Reset password.
